$schema_note: Declarative spec of the in-app UI as built. Values taken from AppRoot.kt and the screen composables; update together with code. The companion overlay is documented separately in companion-overlay.json.

navigation.state: selected tab in rememberSaveable, defaults CHAT

drawer.opened_by: onMenu callback passed to every screen (ScreenHeader menu button)

CHAT.layout: Column: ScreenHeader > engine banner (when not ready) > LazyColumn(messages) > agent banner > input row

messages.list: LazyColumn, auto-scrolls to newest on content change
messages.markdown: assistant messages render via MarkdownMessage (MarkdownUI); user messages plain

CHAT.input: text field + send; web-search toggle and agent toggle above
CHAT.agent_banner: shown when agentEnabled && !generating: 'Agent mode on — model can use web search, calculator, and datetime'
dialogs: model picker / overflow dialog (Dialog in ChatScreen.kt)

sections: HfSearchSection (Hugging Face search, GGUF + MLX, sort dropdown)

SERVER.summary: local API server control and status

KEYS.summary: API key list (KeyRow) with add/edit Dialog

LOGS.summary: ServerLog viewer with export to Downloads

sections: CompanionSettingsSection (character size, mode, VRM import/compress entry points)
SETTINGS.navigation: onOpenTab(Tab) jumps to another tab; Dialog for confirmations

shared_components.name: ToolCallCard
shared_components.purpose: renders one agent tool invocation inline in chat

shared_components.name: VrmCompressDialog
shared_components.purpose: VRM bone-compression effort picker (presets Low/Medium/High/Max/Custom, bones slider, texture-shrink toggle default OFF, progress)

character_renderers.note: content layer beneath/behind UI; listed for completeness, unchanged by UI work
